voice.zh: 听障使用者小林，正在去见朋友。
voice.en: Xiaolin, a deaf or hard-of-hearing user, is on her way to meet a friend.

voice.zh: 她希望独自出行时，也能及时察觉身后的环境线索。
voice.en: She wants to notice important cues behind her while travelling independently.

voice.zh: SoundBridge，让声音成为触觉。
voice.en: SoundBridge turns sound cues into touch.

name: Outdoors
title: 车铃在身后，线索抵达手腕
en: FROM A SOUND BEHIND HER TO A CUE ON HER WRIST

voice.zh: 共享步道上，车铃从左后方传来。小林的目光仍然朝前。
voice.en: A bicycle bell rings behind her on the left. Her attention is on the path ahead.

voice.zh: 声波抵达手表，四个麦克风先后接收同一次声音。
voice.en: The sound reaches the watch. Four microphones receive the same event at different times.

voice.zh: 手表开始识别，让看不见的声音有了可感知的入口。
voice.en: Recognition begins, giving an unseen sound a perceptible form.

name: Recognition
title: 把声音，变成可以理解的线索
en: RECOGNIZE THE SOUND. MAKE THE CUE CLEAR.

voice.zh: 收音信号转换为频谱特征，端侧模型识别出车铃。
voice.en: Audio is converted into spectral features. An on-device model identifies the bicycle bell.

voice.zh: 分类确认后，系统把声音类别与来向交给提醒模块。
voice.en: Once confirmed, the sound class and direction are passed to the alert module.

voice.zh: 从外部声音，到腕上的线索，处理在本地完成。
voice.en: From sound to a cue on the wrist, processing stays local.

name: Direction
title: 四个收音点，共同判断来向

voice.zh: 四个麦克风的位置不同，声音到达的时间也有细微差异。
voice.en: The four microphones occupy different positions, so sound reaches them at slightly different times.

voice.zh: 比较四路信号的先后，阵列估算声音相对手表的来向。
voice.en: Comparing the four arrival times estimates direction relative to the watch.

voice.zh: 左后方、左前方、右前方、右后方，表盘的指针和角度同步变化。
voice.en: Rear left, front left, front right, rear right: the dial pointer and angle move together.

voice.zh: 来向不明确时，只显示声音类别，让她自己观察确认。
voice.en: If direction is unclear, show the sound class and let her check her surroundings.

name: Haptics
title: 三次短振，她抬腕查看
en: A TACTILE CUE. A GLANCE AT THE WRIST.

voice.zh: 小林的手腕感到三次短振，她抬腕查看。
voice.en: Xiaolin feels three short pulses and glances at her watch.

voice.zh: 表盘同时显示车铃、角度和方位文字。
voice.en: The dial shows the bell, its approximate angle and a direction label.

voice.zh: 声音不必成为她回应环境的唯一入口。
voice.en: Hearing does not have to be her only way to notice the world.

name: Response
title: 确认周围，再继续自己的路

voice.zh: 有了来向线索，她转头观察，确认骑行者的位置。
voice.en: With a directional cue, she looks around and locates the cyclist.

voice.zh: 她在步道一侧让出空间，等对方通过，再继续前行。
voice.en: She makes space at the side, lets the rider pass, then continues.

voice.zh: 手表提供线索，行动由她自己决定。
voice.en: The watch provides a cue. The decision remains hers.

name: Personalize
title: 提醒，适合她自己的感受
en: SET THE CUE TO SUIT HER.

voice.zh: 适合自己的提醒，才容易被理解。
voice.en: A cue that suits the person is easier to understand.

voice.zh: 她选择关注的声音，调节振动强度，也可以放大文字。
voice.en: She chooses sounds, adjusts vibration strength and can enlarge the text.

voice.zh: 左侧选中的设置，会立即呈现在手表上。
voice.en: Each selected control is reflected immediately on the watch.

name: Home
title: 门铃响起，也能从容回应
en: NOTICE A VISITOR. RESPOND IN HER OWN TIME.

voice.zh: 回到家，小林正专注于手里的事情，门铃响起。
voice.en: At home, Xiaolin is focused on what she is doing when the doorbell rings.

voice.zh: 两组双振和门铃文字，让来访信息抵达手腕。
voice.en: Two paired pulses and a doorbell label bring the visitor cue to her wrist.

voice.zh: 她可以从容地结束手头的事，再决定何时回应。
voice.en: She can finish what she is doing and choose when to respond.

name: Structure
title: 一份提醒，来自部件之间的协作
en: AN ALERT, BUILT BY WORKING TOGETHER.

voice.zh: 这份提醒，来自表壳内各个部件的协作。
voice.en: This cue is created by components working together inside the case.

voice.zh: 收音阵列、处理电路、显示模组和触觉马达，逐层展开。
voice.en: The microphone array, processing board, display and haptic actuator separate into layers.

voice.zh: 看清信号如何流动后，部件沿原来的位置平稳收回。
voice.en: After revealing the signal path, the layers settle smoothly back into place.

name: Modes
title: 开启与暂停，都由她决定

voice.zh: 她也可以暂停监听，为自己留一段安静的时间。
voice.en: She can also pause listening and take time for herself.

voice.zh: 暂停状态持续可见；准备好了，再由她主动恢复。
voice.en: The paused state stays visible. She chooses when to resume.

name: Privacy
title: 私人的日常，留在自己的掌控中

voice.zh: 声音在本地处理，私人的日常，留在自己的掌控中。
voice.en: Sound is processed locally, keeping her everyday life under her control.

name: Closing
title: 更从容地，过自己的生活

voice.zh: 从独自出门，到与朋友相聚，生活按自己的节奏展开。
voice.en: From heading out alone to meeting a friend, life moves at her own pace.

voice.zh: SoundBridge，让重要的线索，被感知。
voice.en: SoundBridge. Make important cues perceptible.
